name: serio-ngo
description: Open-source deterministic guardrails for Claude Code. Hooks and scripts only — no data, no telemetry, no dependencies.

plugins.name: serio-focus
plugins.description: Budget caps, a git and delete lock, an audit trail and a focus output style for Claude Code. Subagent floods and oversized reads are capped; commit, push and recursive deletes stop before they run. No model call, no API key, no telemetry, no dependencies.
